apps.localizedDescription:
Prayer times for AlRashid Mosque in Edmonton, from the mosque's own timetable. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Live Activity that counts down to the next prayer and flips to the Iqamah countdown at Adhan time, Dynamic Island, an Apple Watch app, Qibla compass (about 25 degrees from north in Edmonton), Quran verse of the day, Adhan sound choices, and large text sizes built in.

Version 2.0.0 | Colored widgets, a proper iPad layout, iPhone Duo, Ramadan mode, a monthly calendar, Iqamah first countdowns, StandBy, Siri and Control Center controls, Sunnah fasting reminders, Minimal Mode, and settings backup to a file or iCloud.
